visual_action: A montage shows Donald Trump walking into a crowded UFC arena, intercut with imagery promoting a UFC event at the White House. UFC CEO Dana White and Trump are shown walking together, looking at plans for an event on the White House South Lawn, and observing a construction site. Close-ups feature a custom UFC championship belt that reads "The WHITE HOUSE SOUTH LAWN JUNE 14, 2026". The video concludes with shots of Trump in the arena crowd, smiling and clapping.
